definitions.explanation: A payment method where you hold a card or smartphone near a reader without inserting or swiping.

examples.japanese: タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}さなくて→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: At convenience stores, you can use contactless payment, so you don't need to get out coins.

notes:
タッチ{決済|けっさい} refers to contactless payment where you hold a card or smartphone near a reader to pay. A wasei-eigo compound combining English "touch" with ⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧ (settlement/payment).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay by contactless
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to support contactless payment
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: contactless payment is available

USAGE:
Covers NFC-based credit/debit cards, transportation IC cards (Suica, PASMO), and smartphone payment apps. The formal term is ⟦{非接触|ひせっしょく}→非接触：15813_hisesshoku⟧⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧.
